style.prompt: Create a painted-comic architectural STYLE CANVAS for the Xhain (Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg) environment assets of an isometric Berlin post-collapse action RPG. Use the attached Potsdamer Platz board as a material/ink/painterly reference, and the attached U-Bahn board for weathered green iron and station ceramic. Architecture should be recognizable with more realistic architectural detail, restrained chips, rust, a few broken panes and ivy, not ruin piles. This is environment-only, no characters or enemies. Layout: one atmospheric top strip of the Spree at dusk with the red brick Gothic Oberbaumbrücke twin copper-spired towers, the severe grey industrial power-station silhouette of Berghain, long Ostbahnhof glass barrel hall; bottom half five clearly separated asset studies: brick pointed-arch arcade, fluted concrete power station with tall slit windows, riveted green elevated railway, vivid abstract East Side Gallery mural segment, ceramic station parapet. Add small swatches: oxblood terracotta brick, oxidized green copper, charcoal concrete, cool teal water, amber, restrained cyan and magenta reflected light. Ink outlines, visible brush textures, top-left light, readable shapes at small game scale. No BVG logos, no transit costume motifs. Use existing architectural identities, no invented towers for Berghain. Dark teal presentation background, landscape canvas, no text needed.

atlas.prompt:
Paint a production material atlas for Xhain architecture in an isometric painted-comic Berlin RPG, based on the attached approved style canvas. EXACT layout: a seamless edge-to-edge FOUR COLUMN by THREE ROW grid of TWELVE equally sized RECTANGULAR cells, no gutters, no borders, no text, no labels, no perspective, no objects sitting in space. Every cell is a flat orthographic texture entirely filled to its edges. Hard grid divisions at x=25%,50%,75% and y=33.333%,66.666%.
ROW 1 left to right: (1) deep terracotta red brick Gothic arcade masonry, restrained buff diamond brick ornament, NO openings, NO arches, NO windows; (2) richer red finely detailed tower brick masonry, subtle pale stone stringcourse across middle, NO windows; (3) aged sea-green copper roof sheeting with thin dark seams, NO building silhouette; (4) Berghain weathered grey warm-cool concrete vertical pilasters and recessed plaster panels, NO windows, NO openings.
ROW 2: (5) Ostbahnhof warm-grey station stone facade masonry with subtle pilaster divisions, NO windows, NO doors; (6) cool blue-green barrel-hall glazing flat texture, thin dark iron glazing grid, reflected pale sky and a few cracked panes; (7) elevated U1 railway green painted riveted steel beams with subtle rust and iron plates, NO scene; (8) Stadtbahn railway red-brown supporting brick masonry with restrained stone cap texture, NO openings.
ROW 3: (9) East Side Gallery original colorful abstract mural, bold cyan cobalt coral yellow magenta angular face/eyes/dove-like abstract shapes across worn ivory plaster, no copied existing mural, no lettering; (10) small old ivory and muted mustard station ceramic tiles with bottle-green trim stripes and rare diamond motifs, slightly chipped; (11) Spree/Landwehrkanal WATER, dark blue-teal current ripples with restrained amber, cyan and magenta broken reflections, top-down, no banks/no objects; (12) station forecourt and bridge deck worn grey-beige stone paving with light moss in cracks, top-down.
Painterly mineral surface feel with ink-edged details, restrained post-apocalyptic wear, good architectural material realism while retaining hand-painted comic language. Saturated district accents but no neon on ordinary masonry, no shadows or gradients across entire cells, no cast shadows. This must be a practical flat texture atlas, not a concept board or building drawing.
